purpose: Teach: 鍛冶/臨場/北極/トップニュース/被写体/防い/訃報/何もの

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療器具、本気で、絶対、鍛冶、絶対、職人、絶対、製作の伝統、絶対、医療界、絶対、続いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, the tradition of skilled craftspeople making medical equipment — it continues in the medical field, and we're truly grateful for it.
lines.style: Steady, clear delivery. Measured pace. Gratitude sits underneath without performance. The voice of someone who has thought about this carefully.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 手術現場の、本気で、絶対、臨場、絶対、感、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、緊張、絶対、されますよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Working in the operating room, you feel that immediacy — the weight of what the medical team carries. It's intense, isn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tentative. He's checking his understanding while speaking. Genuine curiosity underneath the formality. Respectful distance maintained.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。北極、本気で、絶対、観測隊員の、絶対、健康管理、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、ご対応、絶対、いたしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We handle the health of polar expedition teams with the same care and attention. The medical team takes that responsibility seriously.
lines.style: Clear-eyed delivery. Matter-of-fact but not cold. A quiet affirmation of duty. She's not overstating it — she trusts the facts to speak.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新治療の、本気で、絶対、トップニュース、絶対、医療界、絶対、注目されていますね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The new treatments are drawing real attention in the medical world. You can see how much they matter, can't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Engaged but careful. A note of discovery in his voice, like he's putting pieces together as he speaks. Respectful, not deferential.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。研究の、本気で、絶対、被写体、絶対、患者さん、絶対、同意を、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We make absolutely certain patients understand what they're part of. Informed consent — we don't compromise on that.
lines.style: Firm but not sharp. This is a line she draws. Quiet conviction. No apology in her voice, only clarity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感染を、本気で、絶対、防いだ、絶対、医療チームの努力、絶対、本当に、絶対、ありがたいですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: What the medical team did to prevent infection — that took real effort. We should acknowledge that.
lines.style: Softly earnest. He means this. A pause before 'real effort' — he's choosing the right words. Genuine appreciation, not flattery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。先輩医師の、本気で、絶対、訃報、絶対、医療界、絶対、悲しみに、絶対、包まれました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We lost a colleague recently. The whole medical community felt that loss.
lines.style: Brief pause at the start. Steady voice carrying weight without bending under it. She's honoring something true. Not performing grief — containing it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 命とは、本気で、絶対、何もの、絶対、か、絶対、医療現場で、絶対、改めて、絶対、考えさせられますね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: When you're in the medical world, you start asking: what is life, really? These places — they make you reckon with that question.
lines.style: Slow, almost wondering. He's not performing philosophy — he's admitting uncertainty. Real thought happening in real time. Voice trails slightly, like the question stays with him.
